definitions.short: a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)
definitions.full: H5188. netiphah [ נְטִיפָה ?] noun [feminine] drop , i.e. pendant, an ornament (or pearl = Arabic , from likeness to drop of water; compare GFM);-only plural absolute נְטִיפוֺת Judg 8:26 , נְטִפוֺת Isa 3:16 .
